{
  "project": "agentic-knowledge-mapper",
  "what_building": "A risk assessment and knowledge mapping engine for multi-agent LLM systems. It generates structured risk registers and exposure tiers by analyzing product briefs and model architectures.",
  "pipeline": [
    "ingest_brief",
    "map_architecture",
    "score_risk_tiers",
    "map_cve_attacks",
    "emit_register"
  ],
  "inputs": [
    "product_brief",
    "model_description",
    "architecture_variant",
    "empirical_results"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "risk_register",
    "exposure_tier",
    "misuse_potential",
    "residual_risk",
    "knowledge_graph"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.85,
  "evidence_quotes": [
    "Risks and failure modes of multi-agent debate systems",
    "exposure tier",
    "misuse potential",
    "residual risk"
  ]
}
